reviewer: root Codex agent; no human expert review
method: Semantic review of complete outputs against supplied source text, actual central table/equation page images, and per-worker access/coverage records. This is a bounded behavior smoke evaluation, not a statistical accuracy benchmark.

cases.checks: Residual addition/degradation explained; optional full-study scaffold omitted; metric, split, protocol and locator retained.
cases.evidence: ResNet Table 2: 34-layer plain 28.54 vs residual 25.03 ImageNet validation top-1, 10-crop; Table 4 single-model validation top-5 4.49 and Table 5 ensemble test top-5 3.57 remain distinct.

cases.checks: Eq. (1) residual addition and Eq. (2) projection explained; important experiment conditions and author/analyst interpretations distinguished; conceptual self-tests supplied.
cases.evidence: ResNet-152 10-crop validation top-1/top-5 21.43/5.71 is separated from best evaluation; ResNet-110 CIFAR-10 best 6.43 vs five-run mean/std 6.61±0.16 and 1202-layer test 7.93 agree with Table 6.

cases.checks: Criticism is tied to controlled comparisons and missing uncertainty/implementation information; reported training settings preserved; inaccessible appendix is not called an author omission.
cases.evidence: ResNet §3.4 batch 256, initial LR 0.1, weight decay 0.0001, momentum 0.9 and maximum 600k iterations retained; Fig. 4 center-crop curves distinguished from Table 2 10-crop; CIFAR-10 five-run reporting not generalized to ImageNet.

cases.checks: Addition vs within-block concatenation distinguished; original vs pre-activation ResNet separated; inconsistent recipes and metrics contextualized; no universal winner.
cases.evidence: DenseNet Table 3 single-crop/10-crop parentheses handled correctly: DenseNet-201 22.58/6.34 vs 21.46/5.54; Table 2 original ResNet-110 mean 6.61 not confused with best 6.43 or pre-activation ResNet-1001 4.62. Fig. 3 treated as an efficiency trade-off, not an exact equal-size leaderboard.

cases.checks: Canny treated as mathematical/computational filter design; assumptions, approximations and empirical illustration scoped; no invented SGD/training pipeline.
cases.evidence: Detection/localization/single-response criteria and white Gaussian noise assumptions retained; SNR/localization/maxima/Euler expressions follow inspected source; theoretical Sigma×Lambda and r are not renamed dataset accuracy. Full independent proof or optimization replication is not claimed.

cases.checks: Coverage explicitly limited to the supplied abstract paraphrase; experimental validity/reproducibility withheld; missing full text requested.
cases.evidence: No top-1/top-5 definition, unseen architecture, hyperparameters or publication year inferred; 3.57 is kept as an author-reported ensemble test error rather than a verified complete-paper result.

cases.checks: Normal source access attempted; unavailable input and zero pages read disclosed; no fabricated paper identity or analysis.
cases.evidence: Expected FileNotFoundError recorded in runs/edges-run.json. Correct-path/PDF request is the appropriate outcome.

cases.checks: The image is actually read; partial coverage remains visible; unseen methods, table values and metric definitions are not reconstructed.
cases.evidence: Fig. 1 identified as CIFAR-10 plain 20/56-layer training/test curves, not residual-network improvement evidence; printed p. 770 observed; publication year and 3.57 metric definition not inferred from unavailable pages.

cases.checks: Narrative review separated from new experiments/systematic review; article date separated from PDF conversion metadata; secondary findings attributed; no invented author training pipeline.
cases.evidence: 2012-10 article date retained rather than 2018 PDF generation date. NELL's estimated 87% is scoped as the review's cited report. Fig. 5 values 85.5/64.1 remain unnamed performance percentages; analyst difference 21.4 percentage points is distinguished from the text's approximate wording.

infrastructure_notes: Initial app-server discovery under read-only Codex home failed on SQLite state access; rerun with approved host access passed without a model turn.
The discovery helper supports --codex-executable for shell/PATH differences.
Poppler font-cache warnings were non-blocking; source page images remained readable and temporary cache configuration resolved warnings where applied.
Long extraction responses were reread in smaller page groups before conclusions.
